name: Takenos USD
oneLiner: TAKO is Takenos's Solana dollar stablecoin issued through Bridge, backed by issuer-reported cash and Treasury reserves, awaiting an admitted price lane.
collateral: Bridge reports U.S. dollar cash and a Treasury category that includes money-market funds with Treasury-bill ladders of less than three-month duration. Named cash banks, fund allocations, and an independent TAKO reserve attestation were not retrieved.
pegMechanism: Bridge issues TAKO on Solana as a Token-2022 stablecoin connected to Bridge fiat on and off-ramps for Takenos users across Latin America. Default token accounts are initialized with no transfer hook; token-specific direct redemption terms for non-app holders remain unverified.

proofOfReserves.provider: Bridge issuer dashboard and reserve JSON; no independently reconciled TAKO reserve report retrieved

launchPhaseDetail: TAKO is issued on Solana as an open-loop Token-2022 mint with initialized default accounts and no transfer hook. The recorded launch date reflects the first observed mint on Solana; Bridge publishes live supply and reserve categories, but no admitted price lane exists.

milestones.title: TAKO Token-2022 mint is initialized on Solana
milestones.description: The Bridge-linked Solana Token-2022 mint is created with initialized default account state and permanent delegate extension.

milestones.title: First positive TAKO issuance is recorded on Solana
milestones.description: A Token-2022 mintToChecked instruction mints an initial 10 TAKO at the Takenos Solana mint.

listingStatusReview.reason: No admitted price lane: DefiLlama price is null, the exact-mint quote is empty, CoinGecko returns 404 for takenos-usd, and DexScreener reports zero pools. DefiLlama supply and pinned Solana issuance are positive.
